**Spacious Four-Bedroom Detached Family Home**
**Highly Sought-After Residential Development**
**Large Private Rear Garden**
**Excellent Location**
Byrne Malone Estate Agents are delighted to present No. 21 The Grange, Newbridge to the market for sale by private treaty. This impressive and exceptionally well-maintained four-bedroom detached residence is ideally positioned within one of Newbridge's most established and desirable residential developments. Offering generous and versatile accommodation throughout, this superb home is perfectly suited to growing families, those working from home, or anyone seeking spacious living in a mature and convenient location.
Upon entering, you are welcomed by a bright entrance hallway with attractive wooden flooring, creating a warm first impression.To the left, the spacious sitting room features wooden flooring, an open fireplace, and a large picture window that floods the room with natural light, creating a bright and inviting living space.To the right of the hallway is a second reception room offering excellent versatility. Whether used as a family room, TV lounge, home office, playroom, or even a fifth bedroom, this flexible space can easily adapt to suit a family's changing needs.
The spacious kitchen is fully fitted with plenty of storage units and generous worktop space, making it ideal for everyday family life. The adjoining dining area provides a comfortable setting, while a separate formal dining room overlooks the rear garden and features double doors opening onto the patio, creating a wonderful space for entertaining and indoor-outdoor living.
Upstairs, the accommodation comprises four generously proportioned bedrooms, all finished with wooden flooring. The principal bedroom benefits from built-in wardrobes and a neatly presented en-suite bathroom. The remaining three bedrooms are bright, spacious, and ideal for family living. A fully tiled family bathroom completes the first-floor accommodation.
Externally, the property continues to impress. To the front, a cobblelock driveway provides ample off-street parking. The generous rear garden is beautifully enclosed by mature hedging and established shrubs, offering a high degree of privacy along with plenty of space for children to play, outdoor entertaining, or simply relaxing in peaceful surroundings.
The Grange is a mature and highly sought-after residential development ideally located within walking distance of an excellent range of local amenities. Newbridge Train Station is just a short stroll away, providing regular direct services to Dublin Heuston and Tara Street, making this an ideal location for commuters. The M7 motorway is also only minutes away, offering excellent connectivity to Dublin and the wider motorway network. Newbridge town centre is within easy reach and offers an extensive selection of shops, cafÃ©s, restaurants, banks, the Whitewater Shopping Centre, Newbridge Silverware, and a host of everyday conveniences. For sports and leisure enthusiasts, several GAA and soccer clubs are nearby, while the Curragh Racecourse and Newbridge Greyhound Stadium are both within a five-minute drive. Outdoor lovers will also enjoy the close proximity to Pollardstown Fen, Newbridge Linear Park, and the Curragh Plains, providing exceptional walking, running, and recreational opportunities.
